issue.title: test_commits_persistent_filter_small_terminal_png_snapshot captures a frame wait_for_visual_idle accepted but the golden does not match
issue.description:
PROPOSED BY phase bead sase-um.9.5.3 (note #6) during epic sase-um.9.5 ("Complete the
interrupted sase-um.9 release-gate landing"), routed to a task by sase-um.9.5.land on
2026-08-29.

`wait_for_visual_idle` accepted a frame that the golden does not match, on a test whose
widget-level assertions had already passed. Before the screenshot the test asserts the
resolved filter text, the "capped" filter status, and the `[1/2+]` stitches position,
then waits for `pane._diff_cache` and generic visual idle -- so the raced content is
something none of those signals cover. Golden and actual share the same layout, which
rules out the one-row chrome shift that sase-up tracks; the difference is content inside
a settled layout.

Triage should identify which async content is still in flight at screenshot time and add
an explicit semantic wait for it, the same remedy sase-uy prescribes for the sibling
`test_commits_sidecar_filter_png_snapshot` in this file. Filed as its own bead rather
than a +1 on sase-uy because sase-uy's root cause (a bulk regeneration blessed a
pre-brief golden) is established and node-specific, while this node's raced content has
not been identified yet -- corroborating there would assert a shared root cause that has
not been shown.

task_type_fields.evidence:
One CI failure in a 841-test visual job that was otherwise green:

- Full CI run 33226037754, visual-test job 99030887452, SHA 1a1463028: 841 passed,
  1 failed. ACE PNG mismatch on artifacts_stitches_persistent_filter_80x24.png,
  146865 of 632184 pixels (23.2% material). Golden and actual share the same layout.
  The test's own widget assertions ([1/2+] position, "capped" status, resolved query
  bar text) all passed before the screenshot was taken.

Not reproduced serially: the epic's workspace rerun deselected the node because the
visual lane is a pytest extra (FAST_MARKER_EXPRESSION excludes it from
just test/just check/just check-full). A targeted repro therefore needs
`just test-visual -- <node>` under load. Do not mute, and do not rebaseline the golden
until the raced content is identified.
